corePassives.description:
Most of Ichigo's attacks apply Breach Marks to enemies. During Transcendent Power, all of his attacks consume Breach Marks to trigger Breach, dealing Ailment DMG equal to 60% of ATK. While Ichigo is on the field, he continuously applies Breach Points to nearby enemies. Each time Breach Points reach 100, 1 stack of Breach Mark is applied. 
 When Ichigo releases Reason to Swing the Blade, every 4 hit(s) grant 1 stack of Charge, up to 3 stack(s). Each time a technique is released, all Charge stacks are consumed. Each stack increases Crit Rate by 6% for 15 second(s).
corePassives.name: Blade of my Being

rotations.name: 24% Crit Rate (64% on stats page) / 215% Ailment / No Ult Charge
steps: Initial Technique increases Spiritual Pressure gained from the next 2 techniques.
Technique → Basic Attack → Technique → Basic Attack → Technique
Repeat when Technique is off cooldown, hold Dodge to enter Transcendent State and keep spamming Basic Attack until Ultimate is charged.

skills.description:
Ichigo swings his twin Zangetsu to launch consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing 5 hits for a total damage equal to 342%~855% of ATK and applying 2 stack(s) of Breach Mark to enemies. 
 Tap the Technique button immediately after the 3rd, 4th, or 5th basic attack hit to release 3 different Getsuga Tensho skills, respectively, and further build Spiritual Pressure for both Zangetsu. ~~Rapid Flurry~~ Transcendent Power 
 Ichigo attacks the enemy multiple times from different directions, dealing a total damage equal to 2620%~6550% of ATK. Every 1 hit(s) consume 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark from the target and triggers 1 instance(s) of Breach. The damage dealt by Rapid Flurry counts as Ultimate DMG.
skills.name: Reason to Swing the Blade

skills.description:
Ichigo condenses his Spiritual Power to enlarge the slash itself before unleashing it, dealing damage equal to 450%~1125% of ATK, building 50 Spiritual Pressure for his Zangetsu on both hands, and applying 4 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Tap and hold the skill button to charge. When fully charged, it deals damage equal to 675%~1687.5% of ATK and applies 8 stack(s) of Breach Mark. ~~Getsuga - New Moon~~ After Basic Attack 3rd Strike 
 Ichigo swings his left-hand Zangetsu to release Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 360%~900% of ATK and applying 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Releasing this skill builds 25 Spiritual Pressure for his left-hand Zangetsu and can be chained into the 5th hit of his basic attack directly. ~~Getsuga - Dual Crescent~~ After Basic Attack 4th strike 
 Ichigo steps back and unleashes two consecutive Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 420%~1050% of ATK and applying 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Releasing this skill builds 15 Spiritual Pressure for his left-hand Zangetsu and 15 Spiritual Pressure for his right-hand Zangetsu. ~~Getsuga - Full Moon~~ After Basic Attack 5th Strike 
 Ichigo Rushes above the enemy and swings his right-handed Zangetsu to release Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 480%~1200% of ATK and applying 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Releasing this skill builds 25 Spiritual Pressure for his right-hand Zangetsu.
skills.name: Getsuga Tensho

skills.description:
Ichigo consumes all Spiritual Pressure from both Zangetsu and unleashes two Getsuga Tensho in a cross formation, dealing damage equal to 1360%~3400% of ATK and applying 8 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Releasing this skill builds 1 Trascendent Point(s). ~~Getsuga Jujisho - Transcendence~~ Transcendent Power - Full Overcharge 
 Ichigo gathers powerful Spiritual Power and releases Getsuga Jujisho, dealing a total damage equal to 2880%~7200% of ATK. Each hit consumes 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark from the target and triggers 1 instance(s) of Breach.
skills.name: Getsuga Jujisho

skills.description: Ichigo seizes the opening after countering the enemy and launches a multi-hit attack, dealing damage equal to 720%~1800% of ATK and applying 3 stack(s) of Breach Mark to the target.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Ichigo gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds. ~~Beyond Soul Reaper~~ Tap and hold Dodge when reaching 2 Transcendent Points 
 Ichigo instantly unleashes his power, dealing damage equal to 600% of ATK to enemies and entering Transcendent Power. While Transcendent Power is active, his basic attack is enhanced into Rapid Flurry, with each hit granting Ichigo a certain amount of Overcharge. When Overcharge is full, tap Basic Attack to release the Ultimate, Getsuga Jujisho - Transcendence.
skills.name: Flash Step

rationale: Ichigo Kurosaki (Dual Zangetsu) sits in Tier S because he is the strongest Thrust Full Assault currently ingame. Gin still has his uses, but Ichigo outclasses him in any content requiring high DPS.

The majority of Ichigo's damage will come from Ultimates and his Ailment DMG, Breach, and the 3 piece set effect — Duty Borne — increases both. Gin's Stamp set, Mocking Visage, should also perform well. All DMG (Enhanced DMG/Overdrive) passives are recommended, followed by Ultimate DMG. Based on tests, Ult DMG - Full Assault gave the exact same results as Enhanced DMG II.

B6 is highly recommended for P2W players as it pairs very well with Mayuri's own B6. Both increase DMG while the enemy is under Spiritual Dissipation. As for F2Ps, B1 is recommended as it provides an important quality of life, namely, Ichigo gaining 1 stack of Charge every 2 seconds in the backline. This lowers his field time considerably as you would otherwise need to manually gather those stacks (every 4 hits of basic attacks). As of July 15, Tosen might be the only unit who can provide that much field time, and perhaps Ichigo double support teams.

Ichigo's Bond is the only one to increase Thrust Mastery and Ailment Mastery. Toshiro's bond seems to be the next best option based on tests, followed by Gin's bond. ~~Recommended Stats for whales~~: 24% Crit Rate / 215% Ailment / No Ult Charge

W5 provides a flat 40% Crit Rate, and B1 provides an additional 36%, totaling 76%. To reach 100%, you only need 24% more from substats. The weapon's 40% Crit Rate is included in the game's stats page, so it needs to show 64% to reach the maximum value.

215% Ailment is needed to maximize the bonus from Ichigo's third passive, Power Fusion. He gains 0.7% Crit DMG for every 1% Ailment, up to 150% Crit DMG. 150 / 0.7 = 214.2857142857143. If you have Nelliel and Mayuri B4 on your team, then the requirement will decrease. Nelliel's Stamp Set provides 40% Ailment DMG to her team, and Mayuri's B4 provides 50%. With those two in the team, Ichigo merely needs 125% Ailment (though more is still recommended for increased damage).

No Ult Charge is needed as his Ultimate becomes available based on his Spiritual Pressure. Ichigo needs to build 100 Spiritual Pressure for his left and right-handed Zangetsus. Ult Charge does not affect this process.
It is theoretically possible to hold onto Ichigo's Transcendent State (saving it for Spiritual Dissipation while building the next one), but a rotation using this tech has yet to be found.
